featured_reviews.review_text: We had gone for dinner. The service is really fast. Everything we ordered was good. We began with tomato and manchow soup. We then ordered veg crispy which was yum! Followed by roti and paneer corn. The sabji gravy could have been better. We then ended the meal with a rose falooda and fresh lime soda and both of them were good. featured_reviews.name: Pooja K
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve always had a great experience at central peninsula. Their Punjabi dishes are rich and flavorful, and even the South Indian food is authentic and perfectly prepared. What I really love is their Chinese menu, which has always been one of my favorites here.
Some of the vegetarian dishes that stand out for me aare Paneer Butter Masala and makhani, Kadai Paneer, Dal Tadka, and Veg korma, all of which are delicious and well-spiced. Among the starters, the Veg Manchurian, Paneer Chilli, and Veg Spring Rolls are absolutely worth trying.
It’s nice to find a place where multiple cuisines are consistently good, making it a reliable spot whether you’re craving Punjabi, South Indian, or Chinese food. Definitely a place I enjoy visiting again and again.

featured_reviews.name: Akhil Vaidya
featured_reviews.review_text: Gurukripa is a great spot in Sion offering a wide variety of snacks and sweets at affordable prices (around ₹200–₹300 per person). While everything is decent, their samosa truly stands out crispy, flavorful, and absolutely worth trying. It’s no surprise that Gurukripa is well-known for its samosas, which are widely supplied to cinemas and theatres across the city. Definitely recommended for a quick and tasty bite!

featured_reviews.name: Desii Thing
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would have easily given 5 stars, but recently the overall taste seems to have gone slightly down compared to what it used to be.

Still, the samosa with chutney and chole remains their signature and is absolutely worth trying — crisp, flavourful, and perfectly balanced. The gulab jamun is also soft, rich, and makes a great finish to the meal.

They have a wide variety of chaats, North Indian snacks, sweets, and quick bites — most items are decent in quality and value for money. Service is fast, and this place continues to be a popular local landmark with a loyal fan following over the years.

Only minor downsides are the slightly toned-down spice and taste recently, limited seating comfort, and parking challenges due to the busy area.

Overall, still one of the must-try classic spots in Mumbai for samosa-chole lovers — just wish they bring back their old flavour punch!

featured_reviews.review_text:

Needless to say, the best dishes are tikki-chole, samosa-chole, lassi, and the mini cheese samosas. They also offer good low-sugar sweet options for people on a diet.

featured_reviews.review_text:
3 Hrs Lunch Home is one of the best places for lunch and dinner near Antop Hill Post Monorail Station, especially in an area where good dining options are very limited. For anyone working or living nearby, this restaurant is a real relief when it comes to finding tasty food, good service, and a comfortable dining environment at a reasonable price.

The biggest advantage of 3 Hrs Lunch is its  affordable pricing combined with satisfying portions. Whether you are visiting for a quick lunch break or a relaxed dinner, the menu offers good value for money. In this locality, there are hardly any other restaurants that provide such consistent quality at this price point, making 3 Hrs Lunch the preferred choice for many regular customers.

The service is prompt and courteous, with staff members being attentive and helpful. Orders are served on time, which is ideal for office goers who are short on time. Despite being busy during peak hours, the team manages customers efficiently without compromising on service quality.

Another strong point of this place is its cleanliness and hygiene. The dining area is well-maintained, tables are kept clean, and overall hygiene standards are noticeably better than most nearby eateries. The restaurant also features a fully air conditioned dining space, which adds to the comfort, especially during hot and humid days.

The ambience is simple yet pleasant, suitable for families, office staff, and individuals alike. In a location where options for a proper sit down meal are rare, 3 Hrs Lunch stands out as a dependable spot for both lunch and dinner.

Overall, if you are near Antop Hill Post Monorail Station and looking for good food, reasonable prices, clean surroundings, and reliable service, 3 Hrs Lunch is definitely worth visiting.

Had a great experience at Sindh Punjab Sion for pure veg food!
• Cheese Corn Balls – Crispy outside with a creamy, cheesy filling that melts in your mouth.
• Hara Bhara Kebab – Perfectly spiced and soft, with a fresh veggie flavor.

• Pav Bhaji – Rich, buttery, and full of authentic Mumbai taste.
• Amras Puri – Sweet, fresh mango pulp paired beautifully with soft puris.

The food is really tasty, pure, with no artificial colors added, and cooked on electric (not oily), giving it a very homely taste.
They currently have an anniversary offer with 10% off, and also provide home delivery.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for hygienic and delicious pure veg food!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a wonderful dining experience at Sindh Punjab, Sion. The Punjabi sabjis are truly mouth-melting, rich in flavor yet perfectly balanced — you can actually taste the quality of ingredients and the authentic Punjabi touch in every bite. Nothing feels over-spiced or heavy, just comforting and soulful food.

The chapatis are excellent — soft, fresh, well-cooked and made with great quality flour. They pair beautifully with the sabjis and feel homely, just like proper North Indian food should.

What really stands out is the consistent quality. From taste to presentation, everything reflects care and hygiene. Being a pure vegetarian restaurant, they maintain high standards and it shows in the freshness and taste of the food.

Overall, a must-visit for anyone who loves authentic Punjabi vegetarian cuisine. Perfect for family meals, peaceful dining, and anyone looking for wholesome, satisfying food in Sion.

Status Pure Veg Restaurant is located in Sion and it is accurately available on Google Maps hence easy to find.

The restaurant is decent in size with indoor and outdoor seatings available.the outdoor section have steel tables and chairs and the inner section have sofa seating and have AC as well.

This is a vegetarian restaurant and they specialise in North Indian and Chinese cuisine. The menu is huge with a lot to choose from. Prices are not too high and the quantity served is satisfying.

I went here for dinner and the service was fine. Special thanks to Staff Sarwan who took care of our table.

What We Had -
APPETIZERS~
Sabzi Seekh -
Mix vegetable seekh with nice tandoor texture tasted great. Loved the generous amount of vegetables used and salad given on the side. It had nice amount of green chillies used and had some chaat masala used as well to enhance the taste.

Paneer Crispy -
Looked great and tasted brilliant. Fresh paneer tossed in sweet spicy sauce tasted delicious. Loved the sauce as it was flavourful and adding sesame for the crunch was great.

MAINS~
Schezwan Fried Rice -
Simple yet tasty. Rice, veggies made in light spicy schezwan sauce tasted perfect.

DRINKS~
Fresh Lime Soda -
A great drink made to ease up the digestion process.

So the meal at Status was satisfying as the service was on time and food tasted great. Therefore do visit this place.

featured_reviews.name: Alok Shettigar
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re a seafood lover looking for authentic Mangalorean-style delicacies in Mumbai, Sion Lunch Home is the place to be. Located just a five-minute walk from Sion railway station, this eatery has been my go-to spot for the past two years, and I can confidently say it never disappoints.

Ambience & Seating

The place is clean and well-maintained, but it doesn’t have a very large seating capacity. Whether you opt for the AC or non-AC section, expect a waiting time—sometimes as long as 40 minutes to an hour. Due to its immense popularity, the restaurant does not accept reservations, so it’s always bustling with seafood enthusiasts.

Food & Specialties

The main reason for the crowd? The exceptional seafood, prepared in true Mangalorean style. I highly recommend trying their fish thalis and fish fries, which are consistently fresh and flavorful.

Must-Try Dishes:

Prawns Fry – Crispy, well-spiced, and utterly delicious.

Squid Fry – Perfectly cooked and packed with coastal flavors.

Bombil Fry – A Mumbai favorite that’s crispy on the outside, soft inside.

Pomfret Thali – A full-fledged meal featuring succulent pomfret fish.

Surmai Thali – A classic favorite for those who love kingfish.

Neer Dosa – Light, fluffy and an excellent companion to their flavorful gravies.

Mutton Sukka – My personal favorite; the spice blend is simply spot-on.

Fish Platters: A Family Favorite

If you’re visiting with family, the fish platters are a must-try. They offer a great variety and are perfect for sharing, ensuring you get to taste a bit of everything.

Final Verdict

Despite the long waiting time, the experience at Sion Lunch Home is always worth it. The food quality, authentic preparation, and reasonable prices make it one of the best places in Mumbai for seafood lovers. If you enjoy coastal cuisine, this spot should be at the top of your list!

The Bombay Earth is one of the restaurants out of the many others in the premises of Eskay resorts ,it's a pure vegetarian restaurant which offers you some amazing mocktails and some decent cocktails.

The restaurant is quite spacious and usually people come over here in groups for kitty parties and normal dine in .
They offer membership to the resort and also discounts are offered to their members as well on their food bills.

The Vibes of this place is really positive and soothing , the staff is welcoming and sweet to talk.
They gave us some really good suggestions for trying some amazing stuff especially the spinach smoothies which was a shocker to me as I hate spinach , but it turned out to be a blunder .

What we tried goes out like this -

▶️Mocktails
1) Cranberry kiss - from presentation to the taste , from edible flowers at the top to the cranberry and grenadine taste along with the orange juice Everything was perfectly balanced in this amazing Mocktail , highly recommended 🔴

2)Spinach Smoothie - I literally was surprised to hear that it's a spinach smoothie but by the looks it looks decent and the amazin artwork of lemon at the top for presentation was really worth the wait , the mixture of spinach and some kiwi literally didn't make it feel as if I was having spinach smoothie , something which was really worth a try ..

▶️Cocktails
1) Choco Martini -good old cocktail made with coffee liqueur mixed with coffee powder topped with whiskey...every sip was refreshing when coffee liqueur hits your palate

2) Activated Batman - something unique and must try drink ...edible charcoal shaked with whiskey garnish with pineapple sticks...taste was unique as were the ingredients in it

▶️Appetizers
1)Kung pao Potatoes - Chinese style potato fries tossed in Kung pao sauce garnished with sesame seeds... perfectly balanced sweet and sourtaste hits the right note.

2) Tandoori platter - a platter consisting of all the options in the menu from cauliflower to baby potatoes to mushrooms to baby corn Everything was available in the Platter , Different exotic vegetables marinated with different sauces and made up on tandoor , achari aloo was my favourite marinated dish, and so was the baby corn , not to forget the paneer was also delicious the achari seekh kebabs can be a lil juicy as they became a lil dry  , but a good blend very soft and yummy , overall a good platter .

▶️Main course
1)Pot rice -  a mixture of many veggies and loads of rice though the presentation is something that can be worked on the tomatoes at the side make it look more Indian otherwise the taste of the dish is really good to have , the veggies are diced nicely and make it really healthy and a flavour full potrice , enough for two people quite fullfilling and  worth the penny.

▶️Desserts
Mango cream - Seasonal dessert consist of whipped cream mixed with mango juice and garnished with slice of mango slice ,it's the summer special dish and since it's mango season they have mango cream in their dessert section which is presented quite  beautifully and the glass filled with cream and mango juice giving it the sweet and sour taste , making it really delicious and something you should definitely try in the mango special season.highly recommended 🔴

Overall the service is good  , the management is really sweet though they take a lil time which they can improve other then that it's a really good place to look out for , an amazing place for a veggie lover and for someone who wishes to relax and get out of the noise of the city it's a perfect hideout place .

featured_reviews.name: Food Encounterer
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located just alongside the busy Link Road, don’t mistaken it to be a resort with disturbance of the horns of vehicles. The entry lane itself leads you to an entirely different aura. With good parking facility, their surrounding is well maintained with greenery and cleanliness. You’d find families chilling around away from the stress of city life. Proper security lead us to The Bombay Earth located on the first floor. It is a huge area covered with proper lighting’s and couches at one end and chairs at the other, inclusive of a bar counter. Wasting no time we ordered beverages like:
Lychee Punch- A sweet, cloudy drink with petals used for garnishing
Red Bull- well we always need wings!
Ice Tea- Cranberry flavour did taste quite decent.

Our choice of appetisers were:
Fusion Classic Pasta- We were said it had a combination of two types of pastas but it had only spaghetti pasta.
Paneer Hunan- A really good dish one but try if they like Asian cuisine
Creamy Nachos- More like loaded nachos but the sauces and sides could get better taste wise.

While our order arrived, took a walk to the attached gallery which gives a whole view of the resort especially the swimming area and beyond.

Whenever it comes to vegetarian food, nothing better than Paneer Palak comes to mind. We ordered it with Butter Roomali & Butter Kulcha as our breads. It tasted accurate and the breads were quite fulfilling!

Being full with food, there’s always room for desserts and thus,
Triple Sunday (amazing range of triple scoops ice cream like Mastani Irani etc) & Cream Mango (the summer attraction layered with manage and cream simultaneously)were the best of their menu!

The manager showed us around the entire resort which was very humble of her and we’d definitely look forward to revisit.

featured_reviews.name: Pratik Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
So this is the second restaurant that I had the good fortune of visiting inside of eskay resorts. The first one was the Lotus Leaf and I had had an absolutely amazing experience so I decided to visit one more restaurant and that was this - The Bombay Earth.

This one is situated on the first floor of the iconic glass triangular building and boy is this a beautiful place. The ambiance is just too serene. I visited during afternoon and the whole place was flooded with natural light which looked really good.

The other thing that I loved is the colossal menu, purely veg and filled with so many options from Indian, Continental and Oriental cuisine. I was just too confused to select but thankfully the staff was really amazing and helped me to choose the dishes properly.

Here's what I had-

TROPICALE
Started off this mocktail to cool down from the afternoon heat.  Blend of pineapple juice coconut ice cream mango juice and Rose syrup. Kind of tasted like Pina Colada but even more delicious. Just love the shooting taste it had.

PANEER HUNAN
This was a Paneer based starter. Basically it add crispy fried paneer tossed in their chef special hunan sauce. Usually I'm not a fan of the hunan sauce but this was exceptionally good. The paneer was fresh and soft to chew and the hunan sauce tbh is one of the best I've had.

HONEY CHILLI POTATO
This was another starter that I had. it was basically stir fried crispy potatoes cut like french fries, with honey chilli sauce, sesame and spring onions. The initial sweet flavour from honey followed by the spice from chilly is just amazing. Loved it!

PENNE ALFREDO
This was my choice for main course. the pasta was cooked really properly and the white sauce used was just too delicious, it had a proper balance of spices and I just loved each and every bite of it. The quantity was good as well.

SINGLE SUNDAE
Ended the meal with a single Sundae which had basically a  scoop of vanilla icecream beneath which was Orange jelly and dry fruits and some Rose syrup. Just a perfect end to the meal.

featured_reviews.name: Varsha Vartak
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is a late review.
I visited this restaurant on 8th May 2026. My both kids had their exams on 8th May and their centre was between Borivali and Dahisar. After exams we had planned to visit the Ganesh temple at Vazira Naka however, before visiting the temple we decided to eat something as we all 4 had skipped our lunch due to exam stress. We saw Veg Treat restaurant located at Vazira Naka at around 5.30 p.m. we thought that we would get good and hygienic food as all Veg Treat restaurant’s usually have we went there in their AC section. The section was completely empty. Kids ordered Pav Bhaji (their favourite) and I and my husband ordered Rava Onion Sada Dosa and Rava Masala Dosa.

The Dosa’s were below average but the most shocking part was the Pav Bhaji. For the 1st time I saw my 17 year old’s leave the Pav Bhaji without finishing it. Disappointment was quite visible on their faces. Frankly speaking I could not believe that Pav Bhaji from a restaurant would not taste well. So to confirm even I tasted a spoon of Bhaji and was shocked with the taste. Even the Pav Bhaji at road side stalls are 1000 times better tasting then the Pav Bhaji at this restaurant. Total wastage of money as we were charged extra for sitting in AC.

My daughter ate only 1 pav out of the 2 pav’s that is given with the Bhaji in first round and left the remaining pav and Bhaji. And in the other plate which is of my son’s since, he was hungry he somehow ate half the Bhaji but he preferred to eat more of the pav as it is then with Bhaji.

This is the first time that they left Pav Bhaji at all. But that was not the end my kids then ordered 1 lemon soda (salted) and 1 Lime juice. When I called for bill 1 fly fell into my daughters Lime juice in AC section which was still alive. I insisted that I should not be charged for the Lime juice which they were not agreeing instead they were insisting that they will give another Lime juice. However, our mood specially of my kids was as it is off due to bad quality of food and on top of it this fly incident. We didn’t want to have any other thing to eat from this restaurant. Infact, we were going to take parcel for dinner good we didn’t order.

After lot of discussion with the staff finally they didn’t charge for the Lime juice.  However, when I told that they should infact not charge me for Pav Bhaji or should charge half for it as it was not at all good and had only strong flavour of garlic and was sour in taste nothing like a Pav Bhaji but they completely ignored my request. They did not even bother about the review shared by me.

The restaurant is owned by one person and managed by another. The management is pathetic. In fact wanted to speak with the owner hope he sees this review. I have also taken photos and videos (with the fly) in which the scanner of the restaurant placed on the table can been seen. I will upload the photos and videos also on the site if needed.

Save yourself from going in this restaurant. Wish I could give minus points as a review.

I recently ordered food online from this restaurant, and I must say the experience was truly delightful. From the moment I placed my order to the time it arrived at my doorstep, everything was handled smoothly and professionally. The food was delivered on time, and what impressed me the most was the quality of the packaging. Each item was neatly packed in sturdy containers that prevented any spillage or mess, ensuring that the food remained fresh, warm, and intact.

The taste of the food exceeded my expectations. Every dish was flavorful, well-cooked, and seasoned perfectly. It felt like the kind of meal that is prepared with attention and love, not something rushed or carelessly made. Another pleasant surprise was the complimentary items they included with my order. Along with the main dishes, they provided achaar and salad at no extra cost. The achar was tangy and delicious, adding the perfect kick to the meal, while the salad was fresh, crisp, and nicely portioned, complementing the dishes very well.

Overall, I am extremely satisfied with my experience. The combination of timely delivery, great taste, proper packaging, and thoughtful complimentary sides truly enhanced the value of my order. I would definitely recommend this restaurant for anyone looking to enjoy a satisfying and well-prepared meal at home.
